WCAG 2.4.3 + SPA dynamic-content announcement gap: view switches moved no focus and made no SR announcement. Candidate B moves focus to the new view heading and announces via a polite live region, guarded against first paint and active text entry. Full test suite green.

Bug-hunter-confirmed defects fixed with regression tests: (1) habit current-streak reset to 0 every morning before today checked -> grace for today; (2) home execution queue dropped personal todos due later this week (todo<=today vs issue<=weekEnd) -> align to weekEnd so upcoming bucket holds todos; (3) team over-allocation counted on-leave members while avgLoad excluded them -> count active only; (4) event comparator returned 1 for equal keys violating antisymmetry -> return 0. Full suite green.

Computed WCAG contrast: light-theme accents (cyan 3.14, green 3.10, amber 3.22, red 3.85 on #eef2f8) failed AA 4.5:1 for the 260+ small-text usages. Darkened hue-preserving to >=4.5 (blue #1e6bd7, cyan #0b798f, green #0c7e4f, amber #986308, red #cc3443); dark theme untouched (already 6-10:1). Added automated contrast gate. Full suite green.

(1) accessibility-score scanned only index.html -> false negatives; now scans full view-JS markup corpus, score 100 all flags verified real. (2) Removed verified-duplicate light-theme :root block (no intervening override). (3) Defensive guard: DB connection gauge --g no longer emits Infinity when corrupted localStorage has connMax<=0.

renderMarkdown cache was labeled LRU but evicted FIFO, so a hot reused note could be dropped while cold ones survived. Re-insert on hit to make it true LRU. Verified focus-trap, search debounce, and markdown sanitization are already correct (no change). Lint+unit green.

External CVE/version research: DOMPurify 3.4.8 patched vs all 2026 CVEs (0540/15599/41238/41239), 3.4.9/3.4.10 maintenance-only; marked 18.0.5 latest; fuse.js 6.6.2 no known CVE (7.x breaking, deferred). All vendored deps secure & effectively current -> no adoption. Recorded dated audit artifact.

Hunter-#3 confirmed bugs fixed with regression tests: (1) HIGH backup export->import round-trip failed fatally because issues[].body (review/wiki/db issues) and projects[].benchmark* (adoption candidates) were not in import schemas -> added body field + benchmarkObject validator; (2) MED externalResearchSources (array of objects) was flattened to '[object Object]' by cleanStringArray in dashboard-storage extra-key loop, destroying evidence metadata -> preserve object arrays via stableValue; (3) LOW event-reminders start() leaked a duplicate 60s interval (called at init + permission grant) and lastFired Set grew unbounded -> idempotent start()+stop() and daily prune. Full suite green.

Refinement of Loop 213: announcing via BOTH heading focus AND live region double-announces the same view to screen readers. Now prefer heading focus (which announces the heading); fall back to live region only when mid-typing or no heading. Verified WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured is already satisfied (no sticky/fixed header over scroll area). Full suite green.

Hunter-#4 confirmed CRUD/mutation bugs fixed with source regression guards: (1) MED editing a recurring event preserved stale exceptions across repeat-rule/anchor-date changes -> phantom skips; now reset exceptions when recurrence identity changes. (2) MED recycle-bin restore resurrected orphans (issue/task whose project was deleted became invisible + inflated counts; assignee/owner pointed to deleted member) -> refuse restore when parent project gone, scrub dangling member/deps refs. (3) LOW-MED deleteProject left dangling deps in surviving tasks -> scrub removed task ids from other tasks' deps (matches deleteTask contract). Full suite green.

Hunter-#4 Bug 4a: home-execution issue advance undo appended to the bottom of the original lane instead of restoring the exact slot. Snapshot the card that sat just below before moving and pass it as beforeId on undo (fallback position:bottom). Bug 4b (drop in empty area below last card no-ops) left as-is: lower value, DnD regression risk. Full suite green.

Hunter-#5 confirmed interaction bugs fixed (behavioral tests for #1/#3, source guard for #2): (1) MED-HIGH project picker not in the single-key suppression guard -> Tab into picker then n//g-chord fired app actions behind the open picker; added projectPickerIsOpen() to dialogOpen. (2) MED palette Escape lacked stopPropagation -> one Esc closed the palette AND an underlying modal; added stopPropagation. (3) LOW-MED g-chord m/w/d was dead on the calendar view (swallowed by cal-mode switch); cal-mode now yields to a pending g-chord. Latent #4 (shared previousFocus on stacked dialogs) left as-is — not reproducible today. Full suite green.
